scope_of_deliverables.value: Rocky View County is seeking a proponent to conduct an ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review. The scope is detailed in Section A of Appendix D, which includes project overview, background information, project scope, and project team requirements. The deliverables involve analyzing ERP requirements, assessing readiness, and providing a work plan, methodology, and quality assurance plan. Proponents must also provide client references and past experience, and submit a person-hour schedule for each project phase.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: This Request for Proposals (the “RFP”) is an invitation by Rocky View County (the “County”) to qualified prospective proponents to submit proposals for the County’s ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, as further described in Section A of Appendix D of this RFP.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is evaluated on a scale of 0 to 5 and carries a weighting of 25% of the total RFP score. The pricing evaluation is based on the unit rate and total cost basis, using the formula: {(Submitted cost / Lowest cost) * Weight i.e. 25%}. The pricing submission must be a TASK-FEE SCHEDULE (Unit price and Lump-sum price structure) and must be submitted as a separate digital file, not included in the technical proposal. The pricing schedule must be completed as set out in Section F of Appendix D, and the pricing information must be in Canadian ($) funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except for applicable sales taxes, which should be itemized separately. The rates must be all-inclusive, including all labour, equipment, material, travel, insurance, delivery, installation, set-up, and overhead costs.
pricing_structure.quote: Pricing/ Professional Fees: (VALUE: 25%) This criterion evaluates the cost of the services provided by the Proponent, including the competitiveness and transparency of the pricing structure. It also considers the alignment of costs with the proposed scope of work. The Proponent shall provide a TASK-FEE SCHEDULE (Unit price and Lump-sum price structure) showing the following, at a minimum: (a) Proposed Professional Fees (PER PROJECT PHASE) to complete the work described herein, including any required Sub-Consultants. Sample Price Chart at Appendix #C (b) Estimated expenses/disbursements for each phase of the project. (c) Service fees and rates shall be inclusive of all labour, materials, equipment, tools, consumables, indirect costs, insurance, Workers' Compensation, Vacation Pay Assessment, Canada Pension Plan, Employment Insurance, and all other payroll burdens, together with all applicable transportation and set-up costs to and from the job site(s), the Proponent’s overhead and profit, and any other costs detailed or implied in these documents (except as otherwise specified)

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Vendor Shortlisting and Demonstration Preparation: The RFP Evaluation Committee will select the Vendors that will be shortlisted to provide a product demonstration and assist the County in clarifying any outstanding queries with shortlisted Vendors prior to the product demonstration process. Vendor Demonstration Facilitation: Assist the Procurement Personnel with organizing and facilitating each Vendor demonstration, ensuring alignment with the predefined agenda and objectives and that the County provides a conducive environment for practical demonstrations.
